ai_language_tip: Use Spanish (es) across Spain; use Catalan (ca) first in Andorra and match ca/gl/eu if staff greets in regional language; English only in tourist hubs.
english_ok: sometimes — Common in Madrid/Barcelona, coastal resorts, and Andorra ski hotels, but scarce in neighborhood clinics and trades.
politeness: Open with Buenos días/Buenas tardes; friendly-direct tone (tú in casual dining, usted for clinics/older callers); close with muchas gracias, hasta luego.
name_tip: First name suffices for casual dining; clinics, hotels, and official bookings require given name plus two surnames (e.g. Juan García López).
phone_tip: Spain 9 digits (mobile 612 34 56 78 or 7xx, landline 912 34 56 78) read in pairs (6-12-34-56-78); Andorra 6 digits (312 345); WhatsApp/SMS confirms.
time_tip: 24-hour written, 12-hour spoken (las nueve de la noche = 21:00, menos cuarto = :45); lunch is 13:30–16:00 and dinner 20:30–23:00!
number_tip: Clarify seis (6) vs siete (7) and sesenta (60) vs setenta (70); reading 9 digits as 3-2-2-2 prevents dropped digits.
avoid_calling: Avoid afternoon break/siesta (horario partido ~14:00–17:00) for small shops/workshops, restaurant rush 14:00–15:30 and 21:00–22:30, and calls after 21:30.
closed_days: Retail closes Sundays (except tourist zones); many restaurants close Sunday night or Monday; widespread multi-week closures in August (vacaciones de agosto).
booking_channels: TheFork (ElTenedor) and CoverManager for dining; Doctoralia for private doctors; Booksy and Treatwell for salons; WhatsApp Business very popular.
voice_menu: Public health (Salud Responde/CatSalut), private hospital groups (Quirónsalud), banks, telcos, couriers, and ITV centers use keypad/bot IVR.
callback_habits: CoverManager/TheFork sends SMS or WhatsApp reconfirmation links; neighborhood salons and dentists confirm via WhatsApp day before.

restaurant.before_dialing_zh: 西班牙用餐時間極晚（午餐13:30後、晚餐20:30後），太早訂位廚房通常還沒開；熱門餐廳常寄 CoverManager 連結留卡。
usually_asked: Date and meal shift: lunch (comida ~14:00) or dinner (cena ~21:00)
Indoor dining room (salón) vs terrace (terraza) — terrace often has supplement

may_come_up.what: Kitchen closed before 20:30 (only tapas at bar available earlier)
Sends CoverManager SMS link for card no-show guarantee
Terrace table carries 10% supplement or minimum food order

sensitive_asked.what: Requests credit card digits over phone
Demands Bizum deposit transfer right now

clinic.before_dialing_zh: 公立醫療（Centro de Salud）掛號需健保卡號（SIP/CIP）或 App；私立診所與牙醫可電話約但常問保險公司與 DNI。
usually_asked: Private self-pay (particular) vs health insurer (seguro médico: Adeslas, Sanitas, Asisa)
Specialty or dental treatment and first visit status (primera visita/revisión)
Patient full name with two surnames

may_come_up.what: Hospital group call center uses automated IVR menu
Asks exact medical insurance company (sociedad médica) to verify coverage

sensitive_asked.what: Asks DNI/NIE/passport number, health card number, or birth date

beauty.before_dialing_zh: 部分獨立美甲與理髮店（特別是週末）會要求透過 Bizum 先轉小額訂金。
usually_asked: Service requested (corte, mechas/tinte, manicura semipermanente, masaje)
Preferred day and morning vs afternoon slot
Name and mobile number for WhatsApp

may_come_up.what: Directs caller to Booksy or Treatwell app for live calendar

sensitive_asked.what: Requests immediate Bizum transfer deposit to lock appointment

repair.before_dialing_zh: 下午 14:00～16:30 許多傳統修車廠（Taller）午休不接電話；定期驗車（ITV）多須上各自治區網站預約。
usually_asked: Car make/model and license plate (matrícula), or appliance/phone model
Fault description or periodic maintenance/pre-ITV check
Insurance claim vs private repair (por seguro o particular)

may_come_up.what: Official ITV inspection requires online booking with plate number
Quotes written estimate fee (presupuesto) if repair declined

sensitive_asked.what: Asks handset unlock code/PIN over phone
Demands Bizum/transfer upfront for parts

takeout.before_dialing_zh: 烤雞店（asadero）、披薩與家常菜常接電話預訂自取；外送多走 Glovo、Just Eat 或 Uber Eats。
usually_asked: Pickup (para recoger) vs neighborhood delivery (a domicilio)
Exact dishes, rations (raciones/medias), or Sunday paella/roast chicken
Pickup time (Sunday roast/paella sells out early!)

may_come_up.what: Container deposit or bag fee added
Home delivery only via Glovo/Just Eat

sensitive_asked.what: Requests Bizum or card payment over phone before preparing

shop_order.before_dialing_zh: 大型百貨（El Corte Inglés等）走總機轉接，社區肉鋪、魚鋪、書店與糕點店很歡迎電話留貨（encargo）。
usually_asked: Product name, weight/cut, size, or ISBN
Morning vs evening pickup window (mind horario partido!)

may_come_up.what: Shop closes 14:00–17:00; pickup must be outside break hours

sensitive_asked.what: Requests Bizum deposit (señal) for custom cake/special order

change.before_dialing_zh: 綁定 CoverManager 或 TheFork 信用卡擔保的餐廳，晚於時限取消會扣取爽約費。
usually_asked: Name, surnames, and mobile number on reservation

may_come_up.what: No-show/late cancellation penalty applies on card-guaranteed table

sensitive_asked.what: Clinic asks DNI number to look up and move appointment

usually_asked: Specific question (kitchen hours, August holiday closure, terrace dog rule, stock)
Whether caller wants to reserve now

may_come_up.what: Dogs allowed on outdoor terraza only, not indoor dining room
Closed for local fiesta/puente or August holidays

hotel.before_dialing_zh: 鄉村旅宿（Casa rural）與小型旅館（Hostal）常接電話，但多要求信用卡擔保或匯款訂金；大型飯店走總機。
usually_asked: Adults, children, and room type (doble matrimonial vs dos camas)

may_come_up.what: Offers sending email link to complete card guarantee
Andorra/coastal tourist tax payable at check-in

sensitive_asked.what: Requests card number or DNI/passport number over phone
Casa rural demands immediate Bizum/bank transfer deposit

activity.before_dialing_zh: 板網球（Pádel）在西班牙極盛行但多用 Playtomic App 預訂；保齡球、密室與團體活動可電話洽詢。
usually_asked: Court/activity type (pista de pádel, escape room, taller)
Date, start time, and duration (60 or 90 mins for pádel)

may_come_up.what: Pádel club books courts exclusively through Playtomic app

sensitive_asked.what: Requires Bizum or online card deposit to confirm group activity

home_service.before_dialing_zh: 必須提供完整地址（含門牌、樓層幾樓幾室如 3º 2ª）；24小時急修鎖匠（cerrajero）電話報價務必先問清楚出勤費。
usually_asked: Issue type (fontanero, electricista, aire acondicionado, cerrajero)
Street, number, portal/staircase, floor and door (piso/puerta), and postal code
Urgent vs standard appointment (urgencia carries steep surcharge)

may_come_up.what: Quotes call-out fee (desplazamiento) plus 21% IVA (or 4.5% IGI in Andorra)
Home insurance (seguro de hogar) may cover repair free if called directly

sensitive_asked.what: Asks portal entry code or DNI for invoice over phone
Demands Bizum payment before technician departs

pet.before_dialing_zh: 獸醫、寵物美容（peluquería canina）與寄宿皆需預約，寄宿必查晶片與疫苗護照（cartilla/pasaporte）。
usually_asked: Vet consult, grooming cut/stripping, or residencia canina/felina
Rabies, polyvalent, and kennel-cough (tos de las perreras) vaccines

may_come_up.what: Potentially dangerous breed list (PPP) requires license/muzzle rules

sensitive_asked.what: Demands Bizum deposit transfer for boarding

tracking.before_dialing_zh: Correos、SEUR、MRW 全國專線多為自動語音機器人；打地方營業所（delegación）或獨立門市追單才有效。
usually_asked: Tracking or repair slip number (número de seguimiento/resguardo)
Recipient full name and postal code
Delivery status or parcel-shop pickup point (punto pack)

may_come_up.what: National courier line uses voice bot/keypad IVR

sensitive_asked.what: Courier asks recipient DNI number or delivery PIN code (PIN de entrega)

customer_service.before_dialing_zh: 電信（Movistar/Vodafone）、電力（Iberdrola/Endesa）、銀行與航空客服皆有語音選單並核對本人 DNI，AI 無法代辦。
usually_asked: Account holder identity check (titular del contrato)

may_come_up.what: RGPD (GDPR) check refuses non-titular caller

sensitive_asked.what: Asks DNI/NIE, IBAN/card digits, clave, or SMS code

transport.before_dialing_zh: 除了 Cabify、Uber、FreeNow 外，各地 Radio Taxi、安道爾接駁與地方租車行很習慣電話叫車。
usually_asked: Exact street, number, and municipality, plus pickup time

may_come_up.what: Radio Taxi automated dispatch asks confirmation or puts caller in queue
Airport/station supplement or fixed M-30 tariff (Madrid) applies

sensitive_asked.what: Car rental asks DNI/passport or driving license number over phone

property.before_dialing_zh: Idealista / Fotocasa 熱門租盤房仲電話常爆滿，約看房時幾乎必問月收入證明、合約類型與入住人數。
usually_asked: Long-term (larga estancia) vs seasonal rental, occupants, and pets
Employment contract type (indefinido) and monthly net income for rent-default insurance (seguro de impago)

may_come_up.what: Agency requires passing rent-default insurance solvency filter before viewing
Listing only accepts messages via Idealista chat

sensitive_asked.what: Asks DNI/NIE number over phone before viewing
Requests reservation fee before viewing

government_school.before_dialing_zh: 市政廳與機關辦事一律採線上預約（Cita previa），電話僅能問規定或約私立托兒所參觀。
usually_asked: Procedure inquired (empadronamiento, trámites) or nursery tour
Child birth year (0–3 años aula) for guardería/escuela infantil

may_come_up.what: Public office requires booking cita previa online with Cl@ve/DNI
Switchboard uses keypad IVR

sensitive_asked.what: Asks DNI/NIE/passaport or Andorra NIA number
